overview_description.description:
Value Network is a decentralized multichain, open-source prediction markets protocol. 
Prediction markets are a dynamic form of a derivative - Binary Option. A binary option is an exotic financial option in which the payoff is either some fixed/dynamic monetary amount or nothing at all. Value Network provides a safe space for the novice, retail, and institutional investors to quickly and securely place prediction bets furthering Web3 adoption. The protocol is trustless, fully transparent, decentralized.
